name: Team Bulbasaur: Sun Breakers & Ground Momentum
archetype: Intimidate Water pivots, Thick Fat tanks, and Levitate Ground counters.
gym_duel_rationale: Blaine commands blinding Fire sweepers supported by Sun and Ground coverage. Enter his 4v4 arena with Gyarados/Arbok (Intimidate softens physical hits while STAB Aqua Tail extinguishes Fire leads), Sandslash/Primeape (deadly physical cleaner packing STAB Earthquake to flatten Ninetales/Arcanine and 4x Rock Slide to swat down Charizard/Aerodactyl), Alakazam/Weezing (118 SpA Levitate pivot that completely ignores Ground Drill Run from Magmar/Rhydon), and Snorlax (Thick Fat halves all Fire moves while colossal HP shrugs off Charizard's Fire Blast).

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST Grass/Fire powerhouse. Resists Electric and Steel while taking quarter damage from Grass. Takes advantage of Blaine's own Sunny Day to fire instant Solar Beams and boosted Flamethrowers.
513 BST Intimidate bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Arcanine and Aerodactyl immediately upon entry. STAB Aqua Tail washes out Blaine's Fire sweepers.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate makes it completely immune to Ground moves, safely walling Magmar/Rhydon's Drill Run while boosting with Calm Mind.
480 BST physical wrecking ball. STAB Earthquake crushes Magmar/Rhydon and Ninetales/Arcanine, while Close Combat and boosted Crush Claws shatter defensive walls.
540 BST defensive anchor. Thick Fat halves all incoming Fire moves, turning Blaine's strongest Fire Blasts into harmless scratches.

roster.status: Active in Party (Silph Co Gift / Seafoam Catch)
roster.progression_notes: 535 BST bulky water sponge with 130 HP. Fires off high-power Hydro Pumps to overwhelm Fire switch-ins outside of sunlight.

flex_bench.rationale: Compound Eyes Quiver Dance Sleep utility for safe captures and route shutdown (Caterpie family).
High-velocity Electric pivot counter against Flying water routes (Elekid family).
High Jump Kick physical breaker from Fighting Dojo (Tyrogue family).
